column2: [intro]
In a museum or on a city wall,
Art speaks out, the celebration’s a ball.
From wild sculptures to colors so bright,
We get carried away, emotions take flight.
I love accessible art, it's a delight,
A splash of color that brings things to light.
Smiles and laughter, it’s truly a treat,
Art is for everyone, it’s wonderfully sweet.
A little clown on a playful canvas shown,
A painting that makes our heads spin and groan,
Art makes us dream, it sets us free,
With magical emotions that bring joy to see.
I love accessible art, what a cheer,
There are no rules, no censorship here.
Brushes that dance, canvases that speak,
Art brings us together, it’s the spark we seek.
